name: fl-moving-to-florida-domicile
description: Moving to Florida from another state: Florida's lack of a personal income tax, the declaration of domicile under Florida Statutes 222.17 and what it does not prove, the homestead exemption and Save Our Homes cap with the 1 January and 1 March dates, driver licence and vehicle registration time limits, and a move checklist. Routes the old-state residency question to ny-residency-leaving-new-york and us-multi-state-residency-and-allocation.
